rows.topic: No-origin clear happens even on empty input

rows.topic: Eligible scalar conversion without origin

rows.topic: Sparse overwrite retains other indices under explicit origin

rows.topic: Explicit origin0 differs from omitted origin

rows.topic: Absent target with explicit origin and EOF

rows.topic: Skip/count and remainder
rows.script: mapfile -s2 -n1 -t A; code=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$code"; declare -p A; IFS= read -r tail; printf 'remaining=%q\n' "$tail"

rows.topic: Skip beyond EOF and initial clear

rows.topic: Nonnewline delimiter retained by default

rows.topic: Only first delimiter byte selected, trimming

rows.topic: Function local target and restored outer array
rows.script: A=(outer tail); f(){ local A; mapfile -t A; code=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$code"; declare -p A; }; f; printf 'outer\n'; declare -p A

rows.topic: Subshell target changes do not alter parent
rows.script: A=(outer); ( mapfile -t A; code=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$code"; declare -p A ); printf 'parent\n'; declare -p A

rows.topic: Default pipeline target isolation, no lastpipe enablement
rows.script: A=(outer); printf 'pipe\n' | mapfile -t A; code=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$code"; declare -p A

rows.topic: Callback quantum/index/chopped argument and ignored nonzero callback status
rows.script: cb(){ printf 'callback=%s:%q\n' "$1" "$2"; declare -p A; return 7; }; A=(before); mapfile -t -O3 -C cb -c2 A; code=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$code"; declare -p A

rows.topic: Bundles/duplicates/extra operands and non-ASCII delimiter
rows.script: mapfile -tn1 -n2 -- A EXTRA; code=$?; printf 'status=%s\n' "$code"; declare -p A; mapfile -d 'é' -n1 A; code=$?; printf 'nonascii-status=%s\n' "$code"; declare -p A

rows.script: for value in 0 00 +1 ' 1 ' -1 4294967295 4294967296 bad; do A=(before); mapfile -n "$value" A; code=$?; printf 'number=%q;status=%s\n' "$value" "$code"; declare -p A; done
